capabilities: navigate folders in Miller columns with breadcrumbs and keyboard navigation
create, rename, move, duplicate and delete files and folders with multi-select and drag & drop
show recents, core bookmarks and a per-day note calendar as virtual rows
visualize vault disk usage as an interactive sunburst chart
preview files with a Quick Look spacebar preview and a details column
extras: Ships with mobile-specific behaviour (one column at a time, long-press selection, drag & drop disabled on touch). The README notes that plugins decorating the core file explorer won't affect this view.
intentEvidence: Column Explorer replaces Obsidian's file tree with Finder-style Miller columns.
problem: Obsidian's built-in file explorer is a single vertical tree that becomes hard to navigate once a vault has many folders, since expanding a branch pushes everything else off-screen.

relations.evidence: Column Explorer has its own folder-note and folder-icon support built in, so you don't need those

summary: Miller-columns file explorer that replaces Obsidian's single-tree file browser with Finder-style columns, full file management, recents, calendar and disk-usage views.
